title: gatewatch: constitution changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 4a0a14abdb62a9f22cc8964280a8dcb505fc0ba3, docs/CONSTITUTION.md lines 1-142. The commit adds the constitution on the default branch. Article IX requires explicit human review for any merged change to docs/CONSTITUTION.md; git history provides no human-review/sign-off evidence (author and committer are Roger Navelsaker, and no sign-off metadata is present).

title: gatewatch: governance commit title overclaims workflow changes
description: Evidence: commit 4a0a14abdb62a9f22cc8964280a8dcb505fc0ba3, subject 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), with no workflow file changed. Article I requires commit/PR titles to describe their diff truthfully; the subject claims automated-workflow standardization that is absent from the diff.

title: gatewatch: trigger mandate changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 53f1c26476bc4fd8f0dc5046e5f39fc7d403ecd1, .warren/triggers.yaml lines 1-47 (new) and .warren/config.yaml lines 1-21. Article IX protects the auditor trigger entries in .warren/triggers.yaml and requires explicit human review; git history provides no human-review/sign-off evidence (author and committer are Roger Navelsaker, with no sign-off metadata).
